findings.runtimeDiagnostic: The user confirmed client and resolver 2.126. One indexed document mentioned the full plate, but no individually checked candidate matched; catalogue parsing and all six external-source attempts produced no match. A document mention is not itself a confirmed advertisement.
findings.nativeParser: Previous parser af17733 reproduced 13 false negatives on ordinary SVG/optional-end/unstyled/form/footer fixtures in native workerd. These are concrete runtime compatibility defects; the exact production HTML was not captured, so a unique production triggering tag is not asserted.

behavior.matching: Full normalized plate is primary. A make is sufficient input; model, generation, grade, year and VIN are not required identity conditions. Optional valid model/grade are routing hints only.
behavior.priority: After saved/manual hints, one exact-plate search precedes catalogue navigation when make and a search key are present. Unresolved requests retain bounded catalogue and second domain-filtered basic search; at most two search calls.
behavior.searchSource: An allowlisted Trust search document can supply a link when one visible Markdown card block has the exact full plate, a positive manufacturer match, and exactly one associated advertisement ID. URL-only identity claims, multiple plates/IDs, wrong maker or conflicting detail-source ID do not qualify.
behavior.provenance: Search-only evidence uses optional externalVerification.method=search-index, checkedAt is search confirmation time, original added/modified dates are null. UI says 검색 결과 확인 and states that original HTML and current Korean ad status are unconfirmed. Legacy original-page records retain their five-field shape.
behavior.negativePrecedence: Official plate mismatch, inactive, deleted and unknown status are authoritative. A freshly parsed external primary mismatch or explicit Lot/outlink/duplicate-plate identity conflict blocks stale search-index promotion.
behavior.priceGuard: HTML and search-index external evidence both have unavailable price. Automatic capture, OCR, verified-price reuse, manual price application and direct sale-price writes remain blocked for external-only evidence.
behavior.htmlCompatibility: Isolated svg/math-root pass distinguishes a standalone root using only the exact documented No end tag runtime failure; known standalone roots keep following HTML while paired roots remove foreign content. Optional HTML end rules prevent artificial depth. Public GET forms and unstyled primary specs can be read; hidden/private/recommended records remain excluded. Actual depth/node/size caps and unknown-error rejection remain.
behavior.persistence: Optional method is validated, saved via existing owner/revision CAS, restored, and reflected immediately in the current table/cards after ACK. Dirty drafts, peers and view state are preserved.
behavior.diagnostics: Sanitized component versions, bounded evidence counters and seven fixed reason keys; no raw HTML, exception strings, plates, advertisement IDs, URLs or credentials.

validation.independentReview: No additional blocking defects; API/parser/auto-price 413 overlapping tests passed. Native review identified and verified the standalone foreign-root edge case before freeze.
validation.testInfrastructure: One concurrent Chromium fixture navigation timed out; the isolated rerun completed all model-browser scenarios with unchanged source. No implementation retry was hidden.

production.deployment: Exact source and merge Cloudflare s-note checks are recorded after publication in the private final receipt.

limitations: Authenticated production lookup, actual Tavily payload and third-party raw HTML remain unverified from this restricted execution environment. Browser and native HTML fixtures are synthetic; native runtime compatibility is measured directly.
Search-index evidence is a lower-confidence link source, not original-page or current official advertisement/price verification. It can be stale; explicit fresh negative evidence takes precedence.

A resultPlateMatchCount greater than zero does not guarantee that the same block also provides an unambiguous advertisement ID and manufacturer. Such incomplete or contradictory documents remain unconfirmed.
